סיכומי ביקור והמלצות נשמרים כטיוטות לערי: Visit summaries and recommendations are saved as drafts for clinician editing. Only a version explicitly reviewed and approved by a clinician or administrator can be shared. The Resend notification contains a secure link without medical findings; viewing requires email-code verification sent to the approved recipient. The link expires after seven days and can be revoked. The approved version, exact PDF, approving identity and delivery attempts are retained. Editing requires fresh approval.
